summary: Five Point Holdings filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement: a fourth amendment extending its Development Management Agreement with Heritage Fields El Toro, owner of the Great Park Neighborhoods community, through December 31, 2028. Compensation during the third renewal term remains a $13.5 million annual base fee plus incentive compensation equal to 9% of Great Park Venture distributions, with a 6.75% reduced tail rate thereafter. This is a routine management-contract renewal for an entity the registrant already manages, not a control transaction, divestiture, or capital event.
